full_judgment:
Qazi Shafi Uddin, J.: This rule is directed against the judgment and decree dated 10.6.84 passed by the Subordinate Judge, 1st Additional Court, Sylhet in Title Appeal No. 168 of 1982 reversing those dated 10.8.82 passed by the Munsif, 1st Court, Sylhet in Title Suit No. 288 of 1981 rejecting the plaint. 

 5. Being aggrieved and dissatisfied with the judgment and decree passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, 1st Additional Court, Sylhet, the deft-petitioners filed a revisional application under section 115 of the C. P. C. and obtained the present rule.
